title: Stash Loot
mission: Walk each new treasure to its hiding spot
briefing: You carry stolen treasures that must be stashed inside the sorted vault. Walk the exact insert path: compare at every room, choose a corridor, and the new room is built at the first empty spot. Three treasures await.
hints: Follow the same left/right rule as a search; the new room grows at the empty spot you reach.
A glowing ghost door appears when the next step is the empty spot - click it.
